issue.body:
## Problem

`sample-kit report` does not say how many branches have gone stale.

## Fix

Count branches with no commit in the last 30 days and print `stale: <n>` in the report.

## Done when

- [ ] The report prints `stale: <n>`.
- [ ] Tests cover zero stale branches and two stale branches.

pr.title: feat(sample-kit): report the stale branch count
pr.body: Counts branches idle for 30 days and prints the count, with tests for zero and two.
